description: Gate guard, positioned by the Air Force History and Heritage Branch 25 November 2019 and painted in Roulettes markings.
Long-standing East Sale gate guard, issued as an exhibit 18 December 1986 and since refurbished.
Placed in position as a gate guard by the Air Force History and Heritage Branch 25 November 2019.
Transferred to Air Force History and Heritage and displayed on the parade ground inside RAAF Base East Sale.
